scientific_integrity: The original sharp-norm subordination theorem is attributed; all new statements are separated from that premise. The analytic estimate proves the infinite result; the included finite script is corroborative, and no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite real exponent only; no uniform large-exponent rate, exact crossing radii, or complex/nonzero-mean extension. The logarithmic asymptotic is proved but its equivalence to possible unindexed general semigroup results is not externally certified.
title: Universal logarithmic boundary loss and radial return of real Poisson Schwarz contractivity
